'''Talva Ko'lib''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Force Adept]] who was raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Life on Bothawui taught Ko'lib the value of social maneuvering and the Bothan became well placed to gain a position of power on the planet. Following the outbreak of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the forces of the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Ko'lib resisted recruitment efforts that were made by the Alliance on Bothawui, considering the Rebels to be a group of criminals that were fighting a lost cause. However, after the Empire constructed a base on Bothawui and imposed Imperial rule onto the world, Ko'lib finally joined the Alliance and was assigned to serve aboard the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Griffon's Wings]]''. A short time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ''Griffon{{'s}} Wings'' was dispatched by the Alliance to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]]. However, shortly after arriving in the [[Yorgraxx system/Legends|Yorgraxx system]], the ''Griffon{{'s}} Wings'' was attacked by three Imperial [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruiser]]. The transport was forced to crash-land on Yorgraxx and the impact knocked Ko'lib and the rest of the vessel's crew unconscious. After coming around, Ko'lib and the surviving crew encountered [[Arran Flekk]] and [[Vor Harkass]], two Imperial scouts that were stranded on Yorgraxx, and the pair agreed to work with the crew of the ''Griffon{{'s}} Wings'' to find a way off of Yorgraxx. Shortly afterward, the group investigated a nearby [[Fornayh's fortress|Sith fortress]], where they encountered the [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]] [[Quorlac Fornayh]] and the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Jallar Golin]].

==Behind the scenes==
Talva Ko'lib was created by [[Robert Wiese]] and appears in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure ''[[Shadows in the Force]]'', as a pre-generated character that a player of the adventure can choose to role-play as. The players have the choice of determining whether Ko'lib has a [[Gender/Legends|male]] or female gender, and the character's [[canon]] gender is not revealed.
